articles.title_en: Characteristics and influencing factors of risk spillover effects across clean energy stock prices: A comparative analysis during four periods of the COVID-19 pandemic
articles.title_cn: 清洁能源股价间风险溢出效应的特征与影响因素：COVID-19疫情四个时期的比较分析
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the characteristics and influencing factors of risk spillover effects across clean energy stock prices during four periods of the COVID-19 pandemic, using the TVP-VAR-DY model and the TVP-SVAR-SV model. The empirical results suggest that the risk spillover level across clean energy stock prices declined with the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, and the volatility was initially violent. However, as the pandemic began to mitigate and recovery ensued, the risk spillover level rebounded and became stable. After the COVID-19 pandemic, smart grids and three renewable energy sources (photovoltaics, wind energy, and hydropower) were the main transmitters of net risk spillover effects across clean energy stock prices, while the clean and efficient use of traditional energy was always a net risk spillover effects absorber. Regarding influencing factors, the impact of structural factors (net power generation of various types of clean energy) on the risk spillover effect across clean energy stock prices is generally greater than that of external factors (economic factors and political factors), and these effects last longer. Finally, among structural factors, the net power generation of two renewable energy sources—wind energy and photovoltaics—has a greater impact, especially during the outbreak and mitigation period of the COVID-19 pandemic. Beyond renewable energy, the net power generation from smart grids and nuclear power had a significant impact during the post-COVID-19 recovery period. These new findings suggest useful implications for investors and policymakers in the clean energy markets.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文利用TVP-VAR-DY模型和TVP-SVAR-SV模型，探讨了COVID-19疫情四个时期清洁能源股价间风险溢出效应的特征与影响因素。实证结果表明，随着COVID-19疫情的爆发，清洁能源股价间的风险溢出水平有所下降，且波动最初较为剧烈。然而，随着疫情开始缓解和经济复苏，风险溢出水平回升并趋于稳定。在COVID-19疫情之后，智能电网和三种可再生能源（光伏、风能和水电）是清洁能源股价间净风险溢出效应的主要传递者，而传统能源的清洁高效利用始终是净风险溢出效应的吸收者。在影响因素方面，结构性因素（各类清洁能源的净发电量）对清洁能源股价间风险溢出效应的影响总体上大于外部因素（经济因素和政治因素），且这些影响持续时间更长。最后，在结构性因素中，风能和光伏这两种可再生能源的净发电量影响较大，尤其是在COVID-19疫情爆发和缓解期间。除可再生能源外，智能电网和核能的净发电量在COVID-19疫情后的复苏期产生了显著影响。这些新发现对清洁能源市场的投资者和政策制定者具有有用的启示。

articles.title_en: Electricity market crisis in Europe and cross border price effects: A quantile return connectedness analysis
articles.title_cn: 欧洲电力市场危机与跨境价格效应：分位数收益关联性分析
articles.abstract_en: As the interconnection of the European electricity markets and integration of renewables progresses, there is little known about interconnectedness across them at times of market turbulence. The electricity crisis of 2021 and 2023 were significant events that can also provide lessons in the behaviour of integrated markets with high renewables under stress. Despite the impacts of the COVID-19 pandemic and the Russia-Ukraine war on the European energy market, little is known about their effects on the transmission of risks between the electricity markets. We employ the quantile connectedness approach to quantify the return connectedness between eleven key European markets, as well as the natural gas and carbon markets. We then examine the effect of the two crises on the interconnectedness. We find significant return interconnectedness, driven by spillover effects, among the markets. Analysis of connectedness across quantiles shows that the spillover effects are much stronger at tail ends of conditional distribution. Moreover, our results reveal opposite effects from crises on market interconnectedness. While the COVID-19 pandemic reduced the interconnectedness, the Russia-Ukraine war intensified the return shock transmission. Finally, we find that the natural gas and carbon markets are net recipients of return shocks across the quantiles.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着欧洲电力市场互联互通和可再生能源一体化的推进，在市场动荡时期它们之间的关联性仍鲜为人知。2021年和2023年的电力危机是重大事件，也可以为高可再生能源一体化市场在压力下的行为提供经验教训。尽管COVID-19大流行和俄乌战争对欧洲能源市场产生了影响，但关于它们对电力市场之间风险传导的影响知之甚少。我们采用分位数关联性方法来量化十一个主要欧洲市场以及天然气和碳市场之间的收益关联性。然后，我们考察了这两次危机对关联性的影响。我们发现市场间存在显著的收益关联性，由溢出效应驱动。跨分位数的关联性分析表明，溢出效应在条件分布的尾部更为强烈。此外，我们的结果揭示了危机对市场关联性的相反影响。虽然COVID-19大流行降低了关联性，但俄乌战争加剧了收益冲击的传导。最后，我们发现天然气和碳市场在各分位数上是收益冲击的净接收者。

articles.title_en: Can power interconnection buffer economic policy uncertainty? Evidence from countries along the Belt and Road
articles.title_cn: 电力互联能否缓冲经济政策不确定性？来自“一带一路”沿线国家的证据
articles.abstract_en: Regional power interconnection significantly fosters a green economy and sustainable development. It could also promote regional collaboration. This study examines the impact of economic policy uncertainty on electricity trade among the Belt and Road countries from 2000 to 2020. The findings reveal that economic policy uncertainty positively affects electricity trade within these countries, implying that most countries secure energy supply by sustaining or increasing their power trade with other connectable countries to counteract economic policy uncertainty. Economic policy uncertainty coefficients in middle-income countries will be greater than those in high-income countries. Middle-income countries have less mature electricity markets and greater potential for interconnection growth. This study provides implications for countries along the Belt and Road if they foster regional power interconnection through infrastructure construction and regional unified standard formulation.
articles.abstract_cn: 区域电力互联显著促进绿色经济和可持续发展，同时也能推动区域合作。本研究考察了2000年至2020年间经济政策不确定性对“一带一路”国家间电力贸易的影响。研究发现，经济政策不确定性对这些国家间的电力贸易产生正向影响，这意味着大多数国家通过维持或增加与其他可互联国家的电力贸易来保障能源供应，以应对经济政策不确定性。中等收入国家的经济政策不确定性系数将大于高收入国家。中等收入国家的电力市场成熟度较低，互联增长潜力更大。本研究为“一带一路”沿线国家通过基础设施建设和区域统一标准制定来促进区域电力互联提供了启示。

articles.title_en: How aggregate electricity demand responds to hourly wholesale price fluctuations
articles.title_cn: 总电力需求如何响应小时级批发价格波动
articles.abstract_en: Electricity needs to be consumed at the very moment of production, leading wholesale prices to fluctuate widely at (sub-)hourly time scales. This article investigates the response of aggregate electricity demand to such price variations. Using wind energy as an instrument, we estimate a significant and robust short-term price elasticity of about −0.05 in Germany and attribute this to industrial consumers. As the share of consumption that is exposed to real-time prices (currently less than 25%) expands, we expect the aggregated price elasticity to grow.
articles.abstract_cn: 电力必须在生产的瞬间被消费，导致批发价格在（亚）小时时间尺度上大幅波动。本文研究了总电力需求对此类价格变动的响应。利用风能作为工具变量，我们估计出德国显著且稳健的短期价格弹性约为−0.05，并将其归因于工业消费者。随着暴露于实时价格（目前低于25%）的消费份额扩大，我们预计总价格弹性将增长。

articles.title_en: Transition towards a hybrid energy system: Combined effects of renewable portfolio standards and carbon emission trading
articles.title_cn: 向混合能源系统转型：可再生能源配额制与碳排放交易的综合效应
articles.abstract_en: A hybrid energy system (HES) utilizing complementary energy sources allows for high-quality development of renewables. It is a viable pathway in achieving the low-carbon transition of the power sector. Both Renewable Portfolio Standards (RPS) and Carbon Emission Trading (CET) regulate the low-carbon behavior of conventional power enterprises. This highlights the importance of investigating how the policy mix can drive the transition towards hybrid power generation. This paper develops an evolutionary game between local governments and power enterprises to explore the influence of policy-related parameters on the transition to a hybrid energy system. We find that implementing the policy mix is imperative to the transition when the technology cost of a hybrid energy system is not competitive. Power enterprises can control investment costs through the structure of multi-energy power generation, but are also limited by the lack of renewable absorption capacity. We also find an additive effect between RPS and CET, albeit with differences. Raising the price of tradeable green power certificates (TGC) can effectively facilitate the transition under either a single RPS policy or the policy mix. Reducing initial carbon permits makes sense only under the policy mix. Moreover, the coordinated implementation of multiple policies can contribute to the transition more efficiently, but it deserves attention to avoiding policy redundancy.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用互补能源的混合能源系统（HES）能够实现可再生能源的高质量发展，是实现电力部门低碳转型的可行途径。可再生能源配额制（RPS）和碳排放交易（CET）均对传统电力企业的低碳行为进行规制，这凸显了研究政策组合如何推动向混合发电转型的重要性。本文构建了地方政府与电力企业之间的演化博弈，以探讨政策相关参数对混合能源系统转型的影响。我们发现，当混合能源系统的技术成本不具备竞争力时，实施政策组合对转型至关重要。电力企业可以通过多能源发电结构控制投资成本，但也受到可再生能源消纳能力不足的限制。我们还发现RPS与CET之间存在叠加效应，尽管存在差异。提高可交易绿色电力证书（TGC）的价格在单一RPS政策或政策组合下均能有效促进转型。减少初始碳排放配额仅在政策组合下才有意义。此外，多项政策的协调实施可以更有效地促进转型，但需注意避免政策冗余。

articles.title_en: Coal price shocks, investor sentiment, and stock market returns
articles.title_cn: 煤炭价格冲击、投资者情绪与股票市场回报
articles.abstract_en: The development of energy finance and the financialization of bulk commodities has deepened the financial attributes of coal, resulting in coal price shocks not only affecting the macroeconomy through the production sector, but also further affecting the financial market. This study investigates the dynamic impacts of coal price shocks on stock market returns accounting for the macroeconomic path by using a time-varying parameter vector autoregressive with stochastic volatility (TVP-SV-VAR) model, as well as examines the role of investor sentiment in the transmission of coal price shocks to the stock market. The results show that coal price shocks have a significant negative impact on Chinese stock market returns, but the impact degree is time-varying, particularly larger during economic downturns. Moreover, individual investor sentiment provides an important channel in the transmission of coal price shocks to the stock market. Insights gleaned from the findings in this study are useful for coal industry regulation policy formulation, market investment decision-making and energy market risk management.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源金融的发展和大宗商品金融化加深了煤炭的金融属性，导致煤炭价格冲击不仅通过生产部门影响宏观经济，还进一步影响金融市场。本研究使用具有随机波动率的时变参数向量自回归（TVP-SV-VAR）模型，考察了煤炭价格冲击对股票市场回报的动态影响，并考虑了宏观经济路径，同时检验了投资者情绪在煤炭价格冲击向股票市场传导中的作用。结果表明，煤炭价格冲击对中国股票市场回报有显著的负面影响，但影响程度是时变的，尤其是在经济衰退期间影响更大。此外，个人投资者情绪为煤炭价格冲击向股票市场的传导提供了重要渠道。本研究发现的见解对于煤炭行业监管政策的制定、市场投资决策和能源市场风险管理具有参考价值。

articles.title_en: Closing the Efficiency Gap: Insights into curbing the direct rebound effect of residential electricity consumption in Saudi Arabia
articles.title_cn: 缩小效率差距：抑制沙特阿拉伯居民电力消费直接反弹效应的见解
articles.abstract_en: The rebound effect refers to the phenomenon where energy efficiency improvements lead to increased energy consumption, offsetting some of the expected energy savings. This article aims to estimate the direct rebound effect of residential electricity consumption in Saudi Arabia and explores potential solutions to mitigate its impact. Understanding the magnitude of the rebound effect is crucial for policymakers to develop effective energy conservation strategies. This study employs a time-series modeling approach, using a dataset covering 31 years, 1990–2021, and four regions within Saudi Arabia, incorporating various socioeconomic and energy-related variables. The magnitude of the rebound effect in residential electricity consumption in the Kingdom, which varies across regions, ranges from 41% to 71%. Since the inception of the first wave of the energy price reform in 2016, the Kingdom has witnessed a power consumption rebound in the residential sector totaling 39.02 TWh (6.5 Twh per annum), and a total of 28.13 Mt. in CO2 equivalent emissions (4.69 Mt. in CO2 equivalent per annum) during the period of 2016–2021. These findings add to the existing literature on the rebound effect, further enriching our understanding of this complex phenomenon and its implications. They also provide valuable insights for policymakers and energy planners in Saudi Arabia, helping them develop effective strategies to minimize the rebound effect and promote energy conservation.
articles.abstract_cn: 反弹效应是指能源效率提高导致能源消费增加，从而抵消部分预期节能效果的现象。本文旨在估计沙特阿拉伯居民电力消费的直接反弹效应，并探讨减轻其影响的潜在解决方案。了解反弹效应的程度对于政策制定者制定有效的节能策略至关重要。本研究采用时间序列建模方法，使用覆盖31年（1990-2021年）和沙特阿拉伯四个地区的数据集，并纳入各种社会经济和能源相关变量。沙特王国居民电力消费的反弹效应幅度因地区而异，介于41%至71%之间。自2016年第一轮能源价格改革启动以来，沙特王国在2016-2021年期间，居民部门的电力消费反弹总量达到39.02太瓦时（年均6.5太瓦时），二氧化碳当量排放总量达到28.13百万吨（年均4.69百万吨二氧化碳当量）。这些发现补充了现有关于反弹效应的文献，进一步丰富了我们对这一复杂现象及其影响的理解。它们也为沙特阿拉伯的政策制定者和能源规划者提供了宝贵的见解，帮助他们制定有效策略以最小化反弹效应并促进节能。

articles.title_en: Assessing the baseline model of WTI oil and stock returns under financial volatility and spillover effects
articles.title_cn: 金融波动与溢出效应下WTI原油与股票收益基线模型的评估
articles.abstract_en: Do financial volatility shocks matter for WTI oil and stock markets? They should since world economic activity responds to volatility. To investigate this question, we revisit two empirical frameworks widely used in the literature. Our baseline involves the standard identification of oil shocks in structural vector autoregressions (SVAR) with (world) oil supply, demand, and real oil prices. We then propose a global vector autoregressive (GVAR) model integrating 14 major world economies. We introduce the volatility measure (VIX), various stock markets, and compare two oil demand proxies: real economic activity (REA) based on commodity prices and world industrial production (WIP). The results of the impulse response analysis do not indicate major differences across models. However, when measuring the share of oil price variance explained by shocks to VIX (or to U.S. high-bond corporate yield) SVAR overestimates the influence of VIX. We find (world) demand shocks explain a larger part of the variance of oil and stock markets compared to supply shocks. In SVAR, new information coming from a one standard deviation shock to VIX is incorporated negatively and instantaneously on real oil prices: −1.6 for REA and −1.4 for WIP. In GVAR these are reduced slightly to −1.2 from VIX and to −0.6 if coming from corporate bond yield shocks. Our study highlights the sensitivity of econometric results to distinct approaches: one that identifies shocks and another that captures spillover effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 金融波动冲击对WTI原油和股票市场重要吗？它们应该重要，因为世界经济活动会对波动做出反应。为探究这一问题，我们重新审视了文献中广泛使用的两个实证框架。我们的基线涉及在结构向量自回归（SVAR）中标准识别（世界）石油供给、需求和实际油价冲击。随后，我们提出了一个整合14个主要经济体的全球向量自回归（GVAR）模型。我们引入波动率指标（VIX）、各种股票市场，并比较两种石油需求代理变量：基于商品价格的实际经济活动（REA）和世界工业生产（WIP）。脉冲响应分析的结果并未显示模型间存在重大差异。然而，在衡量由VIX（或美国高等级公司债收益率）冲击解释的油价方差份额时，SVAR高估了VIX的影响。我们发现（世界）需求冲击比供给冲击解释了更大部分的石油和股票市场方差。在SVAR中，来自VIX一个标准差冲击的新信息被负面且即时地纳入实际油价：REA为−1.6，WIP为−1.4。在GVAR中，这些数值略微降至VIX的−1.2，若来自公司债收益率冲击则为−0.6。我们的研究强调了计量结果对不同方法的敏感性：一种识别冲击，另一种捕捉溢出效应。

articles.title_en: Cross-regional integration of renewable energy and corporate carbon emissions: Evidence from China's cross-regional surplus renewable energy spot trading pilot
articles.title_cn: 可再生能源跨区域消纳与企业碳排放：来自中国跨区域省间富余可再生能源电力现货交易试点的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using data from A-share listed renewable energy enterprises, this study constructs a quasi-natural experiment with China's Cross-regional Surplus Renewable Energy Spot Trading Pilot policies as the shock and explores its impact on corporate carbon emissions from 2014 to 2021 using the staggered difference-in-differences (DID) model. The results indicate that the Cross-regional Surplus Renewable Energy Spot Trading Pilot can significantly reduce the carbon emissions of renewable energy enterprises in pilot regions during the sample period, demonstrating heterogeneity in regional location, ownership, and corporate social responsibility. The positive effect of the pilot is more pronounced for enterprises in the central region, state-owned enterprises, and enterprises with a high sense of social responsibility. The results remained robust when we applied propensity score matching DID, difference-in-differences-in-differences (DDD), placebo tests, alternative measures and 2SLS instrumental variable tests to further eliminate the interference from other factors. Moreover, in terms of mechanisms, the Cross-regional Surplus Renewable Energy Spot Trading Pilot can reduce corporate carbon emissions by promoting renewable energy consumption and corporate energy efficiency. This study enhances understanding of cross-regional renewable energy integration, expanding discussions on selecting trajectories for energy efficiency and emissions reduction goals in the energy sector. Our findings offer practical examples of how different regions and countries promote the integration of renewable energy markets, thereby contributing to research on renewable energy integration.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用A股上市可再生能源企业数据，本研究以中国跨区域省间富余可再生能源电力现货交易试点政策为冲击构建准自然实验，并采用交错双重差分（DID）模型探讨其对2014年至2021年企业碳排放的影响。结果表明，跨区域省间富余可再生能源电力现货交易试点在样本期内能够显著降低试点地区可再生能源企业的碳排放，并在区域位置、所有权和企业社会责任方面表现出异质性。试点的积极效应在位于中部地区的企业、国有企业和具有高度社会责任意识的企业中更为显著。当我们应用倾向得分匹配DID、三重差分（DDD）、安慰剂检验、替代变量测量和两阶段最小二乘（2SLS）工具变量检验以进一步消除其他因素的干扰时，结果保持稳健。此外，在机制方面，跨区域省间富余可再生能源电力现货交易试点可以通过促进可再生能源消费和企业能源效率来降低企业碳排放。本研究增进了对可再生能源跨区域消纳的理解，扩展了关于能源部门能效和减排目标路径选择的讨论。我们的研究结果为不同地区和国家的可再生能源市场一体化推广提供了实践案例，从而有助于可再生能源消纳的研究。

articles.title_en: Leveraging the power of artificial intelligence toward the energy transition: The key role of the digital economy
articles.title_cn: 利用人工智能的力量推动能源转型：数字经济的关键作用
articles.abstract_en: In recent years, the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) has sparked academic interest in its economic and environmental impacts. Against the backdrop of global warming, this study evaluates the impact of AI on energy transition and constructs an evaluation index system to measure the level of the digital economy, analyzing its role in AI and energy transition. The study first finds that AI positively affects energy transition, whereby as AI advances, the level of energy transition improves. Second, the digital economy plays a positive role in reinforcing the impact of AI on the energy transition. Finally, high-income and middle- and low-income countries exhibit different performances in the energy transition promoted by AI, with a more pronounced impact in resource-dependent countries. These findings offer specific insights for policymakers aiming to advance the energy transition, address regional energy disparities, and achieve low-carbon development.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，人工智能（AI）的快速发展引发了学术界对其经济和环境影响的兴趣。在全球变暖的背景下，本研究评估了AI对能源转型的影响，并构建了一个衡量数字经济发展水平的评价指标体系，分析了其在AI和能源转型中的作用。研究首先发现，AI对能源转型有积极影响，随着AI的进步，能源转型水平得到提高。其次，数字经济在增强AI对能源转型的影响方面发挥着积极作用。最后，高收入国家和中低收入国家在AI推动的能源转型中表现出不同的绩效，在资源依赖型国家中影响更为显著。这些发现为旨在推进能源转型、解决区域能源差异和实现低碳发展的政策制定者提供了具体见解。

articles.title_en: Analyzing fossil fuel commodities' return spillovers during the Russia and Ukraine crisis in the energy market
articles.title_cn: 分析俄罗斯与乌克兰危机期间能源市场中化石燃料商品的回报溢出效应
articles.abstract_en: During the Russia and Ukraine crises, the energy market, including fossil fuel commodities, experienced significant global shocks. This research paper investigates the phenomenon of return spillover across the energy market amid the Russia and Ukraine conflict, utilizing the Diebold and Yilmaz Spillover Framework and EGRACH Model. The study examines daily frequency data from 24 February 2022 to 30 June 2023, focusing on the interconnectedness between various energy commodities: Brent Oil, Carbon Emissions, Crude Oil WTI, Gasoline, Heating Oil, and Natural Gas. The result of the study reports a total spillover index of 36%, indicating a significant spillover during the Russia and Ukraine conflict. Furthermore, the highest dynamic gross directional return spillovers have been reported in Brent Oil compared to the others. However, carbon emissions and natural gas have the lowest spillovers. The study significantly contributes to a deeper understanding of energy commodities by confirming the volatility persistence across the energy market based on the E-GARCH model.
articles.abstract_cn: 在俄罗斯与乌克兰危机期间，包括化石燃料商品在内的能源市场经历了显著的全球冲击。本研究论文利用Diebold和Yilmaz溢出框架及EGRACH模型，调查了俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突期间能源市场中的回报溢出现象。研究考察了从2022年二月24日至2023年六月30日的日度频率数据，重点关注各种能源商品之间的相互联系：布伦特原油、碳排放、WTI原油、汽油、取暖油和天然气。研究结果报告总溢出指数为36%，表明在俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突期间存在显著的溢出效应。此外，与其他商品相比，布伦特原油报告了最高的动态总方向性回报溢出。然而，碳排放和天然气的溢出效应最低。该研究通过基于E-GARCH模型确认能源市场中的波动持续性，显著有助于更深入地理解能源商品。

articles.title_en: Income and fuel price elasticities of car use on micro panel data
articles.title_cn: 基于微观面板数据的汽车使用收入与燃油价格弹性
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the income and fuel price elasticities of private car vehicle kilometres travelled (VKT) using fixed effects on registry micro panel data covering all Swedish households from 1999 to 2018. Such registry data, covering all individuals and cars in the country, are unique to Nordic countries and are comprehensive enough to allow fine segmentation of the population by both income groups and several municipality types. To address potential endogeneity arising if employees receive a wage compensation for long commutes, we apply the temporal changes in earned income tax credits as an instrumental variable. We find lower income and price elasticities (in absolute value) in the large cities, and larger elasticities in suburbs, other cities and in rural areas. We also find that the elasticities decrease with income, excluding the lowest income quartile, having the lowest elasticities. Specifically, we show theoretically and empirically that because the income elasticity varies considerably along the income distribution, the resulting income elasticity depends heavily on how the estimator assigns weight to different income groups, unless the specification explicitly allows for variation in the impact of income on VKT. Moreover, the impact of an income increase depends on to whom the income increase accrues to. For a uniform income increase, 0.2 is the preferred income elasticity. Our preferred long-run fuel price elasticity is −0.53. The short-run elasticities are lower. These elasticities apply to the full population and not only to car owners or drivers.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用覆盖1999年至2018年所有瑞典家庭的登记微观面板数据，通过固定效应估计私人汽车行驶里程（VKT）的收入和燃油价格弹性。此类覆盖全国所有个人和汽车的登记数据是北欧国家独有的，且足够全面，能够按收入群体和多种市镇类型对人口进行精细划分。为应对员工因长途通勤获得工资补偿可能产生的内生性问题，我们采用劳动收入税收抵免的时间变化作为工具变量。我们发现大城市中的收入和价格弹性（绝对值）较低，而郊区、其他城市和农村地区的弹性较大。我们还发现弹性随收入增加而下降，但最低收入四分位数的弹性最低。具体而言，我们从理论和实证上表明，由于收入弹性沿收入分布变化显著，除非模型明确允许收入对行驶里程的影响存在变化，否则所得收入弹性在很大程度上取决于估计量如何对不同收入群体赋予权重。此外，收入增加的影响取决于收入增加归属于谁。对于统一的收入增加，首选收入弹性为0.2。我们首选的长期燃油价格弹性为−0.53。短期弹性较低。这些弹性适用于全部人口，而不仅仅是车主或驾驶员。

articles.title_en: The economics of public transport electrification: The charging dilemma
articles.title_cn: 公共交通电气化的经济学：充电困境
articles.abstract_en: The electrification of public transport has the potential to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions and support the electricity system, however this potential depends on how intraday charging interfaces with grid emissions and wholesale prices. Our paper explores these trade-offs by using boundary analysis to evaluate a least-cost tariff-based aggregate bus fleet charging strategy and comparing it to charging strategies that either minimise indirect greenhouse gas emissions or wholesale price exposure, based on the metropolitan Melbourne bus network. We develop a novel two-state fleet charging optimisation model, that allows us to perform a counterfactual analysis across 5 years of historical (2017–2021) and 5 years of modelled (2022–2026) changes to wholesale electricity prices and emission intensities in Australia's National Electricity Market, in response to the three charging strategies. We find that current Australian commercial tariff structures with high daytime volumetric usage and demand charges mute climate and wholesale market signals. By charging to minimise greenhouse gas emissions over bill savings, the fleet can achieve (on average) a further 33.4% reduction in indirect emissions but incurs a 103% increase in annual electricity bills. Alternatively, by charging to minimise wholesale price exposure, the fleet can achieve (on average) a 13.4% reduction in indirect emissions while incurring a 69% increase in electricity bills. Improving the temporal alignment of commercial electricity tariffs with wholesale prices should thus simultaneously reduce indirect emissions and wholesale electricity costs. This necessitates urgent tariff reforms to allow relevant wholesale price signals to pass through to commercial EV operators.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共交通的电气化有潜力减少温室气体排放并支持电力系统，然而这一潜力取决于日内充电如何与电网排放和批发电价相互作用。我们的论文通过使用边界分析来评估基于最低成本电价的聚合公交车队充电策略，并将其与基于墨尔本大都会公交网络的、旨在最小化间接温室气体排放或批发电价风险的充电策略进行比较，从而探讨这些权衡。我们开发了一个新颖的两状态车队充电优化模型，使我们能够在澳大利亚国家电力市场的5年历史数据（2017-2021）和5年模拟数据（2022-2026）中，针对三种充电策略，对批发电价和排放强度的变化进行反事实分析。我们发现，当前澳大利亚商业电价结构中高日间容量使用费和需求费用削弱了气候和批发市场信号。通过以最小化温室气体排放而非节省电费的方式进行充电，车队平均可以实现间接排放进一步减少33.4%，但年度电费增加103%。或者，通过以最小化批发电价风险的方式进行充电，车队平均可以实现间接排放减少13.4%，同时电费增加69%。因此，改善商业电价与批发价格的时间一致性应能同时减少间接排放和批发电费。这迫切需要电价改革，以使相关的批发价格信号传递给商业电动汽车运营商。

articles.title_en: Wind power and the cost of local compensation schemes: A Swedish revenue sharing policy simulation
articles.title_cn: 风电与地方补偿方案的成本：瑞典收入分享政策的模拟研究
articles.abstract_en: Local resistance towards wind power is a central challenge for the energy transition, implying that legally imposed compensation schemes for nearby residents may become prevalent in the near future. I use GIS-coded data on detached residential buildings in Sweden to simulate a variety of revenue sharing schemes applied to every present and planned commercial scale wind power project, focusing on documenting the impact on investor costs. I compare models that entitle compensation for distances between six and ten times the tip height of the closest turbine, imposing schemes that are both constant within the eligible distance, as well as declining with the distance from the turbine. When compensations are awarded for residents as far away as ten times the turbine height, foregone revenues exceed two percent for one-fourth of the projects in the southern region even under the declining model, indicating that the scheme could have a substantive effect on the localization decisions of future investments.
articles.abstract_cn: 地方对风电的抵制是能源转型的核心挑战，这意味着对附近居民实施法定补偿方案可能在不久的将来变得普遍。我利用瑞典独栋住宅建筑的GIS编码数据，模拟了适用于每个现有和规划中的商业规模风电项目的各种收入分享方案，重点记录对投资者成本的影响。我比较了在距离最近涡轮机叶尖高度六倍到十倍之间赋予补偿权利的模型，并施加了在合格距离内恒定以及随距涡轮机距离递减的方案。当对远至涡轮机高度十倍的居民给予补偿时，即使在递减模型下，南部地区四分之一项目的放弃收入也超过百分之二，这表明该方案可能对未来投资选址决策产生实质性影响。

articles.title_en: Who can benefit from multi-license oil concessionaires valuation?
articles.title_cn: 谁能从多许可证石油特许权评估中受益？
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we study the interactions between a public body and several potential concession holders. We propose a dynamic stochastic optimization problem providing the optimal exercise price of the “expropriation” option, which safeguards the social interest from over-exploitation of the resource. Other crucial quantities are also determined, such as the optimal value of the option and the condition for mutual convenience to enter the deal. We apply the model to a Southern Italy oilfield finding that the deal was in the common interest and that the optimal expropriation value is quite high.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们研究了公共机构与多个潜在特许权持有者之间的相互作用。我们提出了一个动态随机优化问题，提供了“征用”期权的最优执行价格，该期权保障社会利益免受资源过度开发的影响。还确定了其他关键量，如期权的最优价值和进入交易的互惠便利条件。我们将该模型应用于意大利南部的一个油田，发现该交易符合共同利益，且最优征用价值相当高。

articles.title_en: Speeches in the green: The political discourse of green central banking
articles.title_cn: 绿色演讲：绿色中央银行业的政治话语
articles.abstract_en: In this paper, we employ a keyword-assisted topic model to quantify the extent of climate-related communication of central banks. We find evidence for a significant increase in climate-related speeches by central banks, which address the topic mostly in parallel with issues related to financial stability, whereas monetary policy and price stability are less emphasized. Finally, we examine factors that can explain the extent of green communication by central banks. Controlling for macroeconomic and climate-related variables, we identify two external factors that can prompt central banks to increase green communication: First, peer pressure, as measured by membership in Network for Greening the Financial System (NGFS), increases green communication. Second, a high degree of governmental climate engagement, reflected by the scope of national climate policies, correlates positively with central banks’ green communication. Whether the central bank has an implicit or explicit sustainability mandate, however, does not explain the extent of green communication.
articles.abstract_cn: 在本文中，我们采用关键词辅助主题模型来量化中央银行气候相关沟通的程度。我们发现证据表明，中央银行的气候相关演讲显著增加，这些演讲主要与金融稳定相关的问题并行讨论，而货币政策和价格稳定则较少被强调。最后，我们考察了能够解释中央银行绿色沟通程度的因素。在控制宏观经济和气候相关变量后，我们识别出两个能够促使中央银行增加绿色沟通的外部因素：第一，同行压力，以加入央行绿色金融网络（NGFS）的成员身份衡量，会增加绿色沟通。第二，政府气候参与程度高，反映在国家气候政策的范围上，与中央银行的绿色沟通正相关。然而，中央银行是否具有隐性或显性的可持续性授权并不能解释绿色沟通的程度。

articles.title_en: Price effects of residents' consumption carbon emissions: Evidence from rural and urban China
articles.title_cn: 居民消费碳排放的价格效应：来自中国农村与城市的证据
articles.abstract_en: Price policy applied to specific products may mitigate consumption carbon emissions (CCE). Nevertheless, the extent to which price effects, such as carbon taxes, differ across income groups and between rural and urban areas in China remains uncertain. With unbalanced provincial panel data from 1999 to 2020, we estimated the demand elasticities of eight major groups of consumer goods and services across income groups separately in rural and urban areas of China, using the Quadratic Almost Ideal Demand System (QUAIDS) and the Exact Affine Stone Index Implicit Marshallian demand system (EASI) in this study. The estimated price elasticities were then used to predict the impact of different price policies on CCE. The results show that taxing the wealthiest individuals and subsidizing the poorest individuals in both rural and urban areas have a beneficial impact on the reduction in CCE. Moreover, expanding transfer payments can further facilitate reductions in CCE. Our findings suggest that achieving CCE equality can be realized through intra-urban and intra-rural transfers, as well as urban-rural transfers achieved by taxing urban residents and subsidizing rural residents.
articles.abstract_cn: 对特定产品实施价格政策可能减少消费碳排放（CCE）。然而，价格效应（如碳税）在中国不同收入群体以及城乡之间的差异程度仍不确定。利用1999年至2020年的非平衡省级面板数据，本研究采用二次几乎理想需求系统（QUAIDS）和精确仿射Stone指数隐式马歇尔需求系统（EASI），分别估计了中国农村和城市地区不同收入群体的八大类消费品和服务的需求弹性。随后，利用估计的价格弹性预测不同价格政策对CCE的影响。结果表明，在农村和城市地区，对最富裕人群征税并对最贫困人群补贴，对减少CCE具有有益影响。此外，扩大转移支付可以进一步促进CCE的减少。我们的研究结果表明，通过城市内部和农村内部的转移支付，以及通过对城市居民征税和补贴农村居民实现的城乡转移支付，可以实现CCE的公平性。

articles.title_en: Regulation of environmental, social and governance disclosure greenwashing behaviors considering the risk preference of enterprises
articles.title_cn: 考虑企业风险偏好的环境、社会和治理信息披露漂绿行为规制研究
articles.abstract_en: The greenwashing behaviors (GWBs) of enterprises have become the primary obstacle of environmental, social and governance (ESG) disclosure. This paper focuses on the collaborative regulation of GWBs in ESG disclosure; explores the interactive behavior among governments, enterprises, and investors; and presents the tripartite evolutionary game (Model I). We further analyze the stability strategy and key influence factors of each participant. Subsequently, considering enterprises' risk preference, the extended tripartite game model (Model II) is also investigated. Finally, we reveal evolutionarily stable strategies and conduct a sensitivity analysis using the simulation. The results demonstrate the following: 1) the initial strategy selection of participants is critical to the evolution of equilibrium strategies; 2) punishment combats GWBs more effectively than reward, with only moderate punishment and reward intensity being conducive to preventing greenwashing; and 3) when enterprises are risk aversion, strengthening regulation is more effective in preventing GWBs. This paper gives a new perspective for preventing greenwashing in ESG disclosure from the insights of collaborative regulation and provides policymakers significant references to improve ESG greenwashing governance.
articles.abstract_cn: 企业的漂绿行为已成为环境、社会和治理信息披露的主要障碍。本文聚焦于ESG信息披露中漂绿行为的协同规制；探讨政府、企业和投资者之间的互动行为；并提出三方演化博弈模型（模型I）。我们进一步分析了各参与者的稳定性策略和关键影响因素。随后，考虑企业的风险偏好，还研究了扩展的三方博弈模型（模型II）。最后，我们揭示了演化稳定策略，并利用仿真进行了敏感性分析。结果表明：1参与者的初始策略选择对均衡策略的演化至关重要；2惩罚比奖励更能有效遏制漂绿行为，只有适度的惩罚和奖励强度才有利于防止漂绿；3当企业风险规避时，加强监管在防止漂绿行为方面更为有效。本文从协同规制的视角为ESG信息披露中的漂绿防范提供了新视角，并为政策制定者改进ESG漂绿治理提供了重要参考。

articles.title_en: Green bonds: Fueling green innovation or just a fad?
articles.title_cn: 绿色债券：推动绿色创新还是仅仅是一时风尚？
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the impact of green bond issuance on green innovation and its underlying mechanisms. We find that green bond issuance promotes green innovation, with stronger effects observed in regions with weaker climate regulation, industries exhibiting better environmental performance, and firms with more concentrated ownership. Further analysis reveals that corporate green bonds facilitate the reallocation of investment capital into research and development, effectively mitigating financial constraints on green innovation. This upsurge in green innovation not only enhances financial performance but also yields specific environmental benefits, such as improved environmental investment and ESG performance. These empirical results underscore the significance of green finance in fostering sustainable corporate innovation and advancing climate governance, rather than merely engaging in greenwashing practices.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了绿色债券发行对绿色创新的影响及其内在机制。我们发现，绿色债券发行促进了绿色创新，在气候监管较弱的地区、环境绩效较好的行业以及所有权更集中的公司中，这种效应更为显著。进一步分析表明，企业绿色债券促进了投资资本向研发的重新配置，有效缓解了绿色创新的融资约束。绿色创新的激增不仅提升了财务绩效，还带来了具体环境效益，如改善了环境投资和ESG绩效。这些实证结果强调了绿色金融在促进企业可持续创新和推进气候治理中的重要性，而非仅仅是漂绿行为。

articles.title_en: Insurer hedging amidst the interplay of black and green swans toward SDGs 3 and 7
articles.title_cn: 保险公司在黑色与绿色天鹅交织下针对可持续发展目标3和7的对冲策略
articles.abstract_en: Amid regional conflicts and global warming, the interplay of catastrophic events (black swans) and sustainability issues (green swans) emerges, impacting sustainable insurance and environmental initiatives tied to Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) 3 (Good Health and Well-being) and 7 (Affordable and Clean Energy). This paper develops a structure-break down-and-out option model to investigate insurer hedging strategies toward SDGs 3 and 7 in the context of sustainable insurance amidst the intertwined dance of black and green swans. There are several main results shown as follows. Enhancing hedging strategies bolsters an insurer's interest margin and mitigates default risk. As the impact of events like regional conflicts and global warming intensifies, the adverse effects of hedging on default risk become clearer, enhancing insurance stability. Both black and green swan events positively affect the insurer's interest margin and default risk. Strict capital regulations are vital for sustainable insurance, safeguarding policyholders and fostering stability during extreme events. In essence, employing robust hedging strategies and adhering to rigorous capital regulations within the framework of sustainable insurance, considering both black and green swan events, proves to be instrumental in advancing toward the achievement of SDGs 3 and 7.
articles.abstract_cn: 在区域冲突和全球变暖的背景下，灾难性事件（黑色天鹅）与可持续性问题（绿色天鹅）的相互作用显现出来，影响着与可持续发展目标（SDGs）3（良好健康与福祉）和7（经济适用的清洁能源）相关的可持续保险和环境倡议。本文构建了一个结构突变向下敲出期权模型，以研究在黑色与绿色天鹅交织舞蹈的背景下，可持续保险中保险公司针对SDGs 3和7的对冲策略。主要结果如下：加强对冲策略能提高保险公司的利差并降低违约风险。随着区域冲突和全球变暖等事件影响的加剧，对冲对违约风险的不利影响变得更加明显，从而增强了保险稳定性。黑色和绿色天鹅事件均对保险公司的利差和违约风险产生正向影响。严格的资本监管对于可持续保险至关重要，能在极端事件中保护保单持有人并促进稳定性。总之，在可持续保险框架内，考虑黑色和绿色天鹅事件，采用稳健的对冲策略并遵守严格的资本监管，对于推进实现SDGs 3和7具有重要作用。
